name: Yonkers

neighborhoods.name: Getty Square / Downtown
neighborhoods.homes: prewar apartment buildings and new waterfront towers

housing: Yonkers renters live mostly in prewar and mid-century apartment buildings and two- and three-family houses, with new towers on the waterfront.

localRules.text: Many older Yonkers apartment buildings are rent-stabilized under the Emergency Tenant Protection Act, with rent increases set by the Westchester County Rent Guidelines Board.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Services of the Hudson Valley
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income tenants, with a Yonkers office

tenantHelp.name: Westchester County rent control information
tenantHelp.what: rules and help for rent-stabilized tenants

climate: Test the heat and hot water and check radiators and windows; winters are cold.
fact: Yonkers has thousands of rent-stabilized apartments, so check whether your unit is one before signing.
